faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Feel free to reach out to us.

items.q: How long does a project usually take?
items.a: It depends on the project's complexity. A simple corporate site takes 2-4 weeks, while a complex web app or marketplace can take 3-6 months. We define the exact timeline during the analysis stage.
We prepare an individual quote for every project, based on functionality, design complexity and integrations. During a free consultation we'll give you an exact estimate and timeline.

items.q: Is there technical support after launch?
items.a: Yes. Every project includes at least 3 months of free technical support, after which we offer flexible ongoing support packages.

items.q: Can you upgrade my existing website?
items.a: Absolutely. We'll review your existing code and recommend whether to refactor it or migrate it to modern technology.

items.q: Which payment systems can you integrate?
items.a: We work with local systems like Click, Payme, Uzcard and Humo, as well as international ones like Stripe and PayPal.
